title: Total flavonoids of Epimedium ameliorate testicular damage via keap1-Nrf2/ARE signalling and multi-target regulation.
authors: Yuan, Hongchao; Tian, Wenhao; Hao, Hao; Kang, Sirui; Jia, Fanfan; Chen, Kai; Zhang, Xiaoying; Chen, Chen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究淫羊藿总黄酮对肥胖致睾丸损伤的保护作用，虽用分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: This study investigates the protective effects of total flavonoids of Epimedium (TFE) against obesity-induced testicular damage in mice. The potential pharmacological mechanisms were predicted using network pharmacology, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation. In vivo experiments were conducted in mice randomly assigned to five groups: a normal diet group, a high-fat diet (HFD) group, two TFE groups, and a positive control group. Biomarkers including dihydrotestosterone and testosterone were measured to evaluate testicular function, while lipid profiles were assessed. Oxidative stress was determined through glutathione (GSH), superoxide dismutase (SOD), and malondialdehyde (MDA) assays, and protein expression of heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), NAD(P)H quinone dehydrogenase 1 (NQO1), nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), and Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) was analysed. Network pharmacology identified 29 flavonoids and 288 key targets. Molecular docking revealed that 22 active components exhibited strong binding activity, with PLCZ1-isoginkgetin/bilobetin showing the most stable conformation. TFE treatment significantly improved testicular function and mitigated obesity-induced male infertility. It enhanced sperm quality, reversed HFD-induced reductions in sperm count and motility, decreased malformation rates, normalized serum testosterone and dihydrotestosterone levels, ameliorated oxidative stress by enhancing antioxidant enzyme activity (GSH) and reducing lipid peroxidation (MDA), and improved lipid profiles by lowering triglycerides (TG) while increasing high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C). Mechanistically, TFE upregulated Nrf2 pathway components (HO-1, NQO1) and modulated Keap1 expression. Collectively, these findings establish that the protective effects of TFE against obesity-induced testicular damage are mediated by the coordinated regulation of oxidative stress and key testicular targets.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了淫羊藿总黄酮（TFE）对肥胖诱导的小鼠睾丸损伤的保护作用。通过网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学模拟预测了潜在的药理机制。体内实验将小鼠随机分为五组：正常饮食组、高脂饮食（HFD）组、两个TFE组和阳性对照组。测量了包括双氢睾酮和睾酮在内的生物标志物以评估睾丸功能，同时评估了脂质谱。通过谷胱甘肽（GSH）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和丙二醛（MDA）测定评估氧化应激，并分析了血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）、NAD(P)H醌脱氢酶1（NQO1）、核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）和Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）的蛋白表达。网络药理学鉴定了29种黄酮类化合物和288个关键靶点。分子对接显示，22种活性成分表现出强结合活性，其中PLCZ1-异银杏双黄酮/白果素复合物构象最稳定。TFE处理显著改善了睾丸功能并减轻了肥胖诱导的男性不育。它提高了精子质量，逆转了HFD诱导的精子数量和活力下降，降低了畸形率，使血清睾酮和双氢睾酮水平正常化，通过增强抗氧化酶活性（GSH）和减少脂质过氧化（MDA）改善了氧化应激，并通过降低甘油三酯（TG）同时增加高密度脂蛋白胆固醇（HDL-C）改善了脂质谱。机制上，TFE上调了Nrf2通路组分（HO-1、NQO1）并调节了Keap1表达。综合来看，这些发现表明TFE对肥胖诱导的睾丸损伤的保护作用是通过氧化应激和关键睾丸靶点的协调调节介导的。
